fixtureAudit.productionExposureRisk: ZERO — Fixture credentials are explicitly test-only and cannot resolve or authenticate against production
fixtureAudit.environmentCleanliness: isSupabaseConfigured correctly saved in beforeAll and restored in afterAll / afterEach across all test suites

dmUnreadCountAudit.vulnerabilityIdentified: In Directive 116, non-production fallbacks (if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') return reply.send({ success: true, count: 0 })) were added to convError, countError, and catch block in GET /api/v1/dm/unread-count. This masked genuine database query errors, returned fake zero unread counts, and caused network timeout delays during tests.
dmUnreadCountAudit.remediationAction: Removed all non-production fallbacks from apps/api/src/routes/dm.ts unread-count handler. The route now strictly fails closed with 500 DATABASE_ERROR on any query error in all environments. Added explicit database client mocks in test suites.
